assessment.security_status_cs: Regionální napětí v Asii nadále roste v důsledku amerických vojenských kroků, jako je nasazení protilodních systémů NMESIS na japonském ostrově Jonačuni, a pokračujících provokací Severní Koreje. Na ekonomické frontě Čína mezitím posiluje svou pozici v oblasti kritických surovin expanzí nalezišť lithium a technologickou spoluprací, zatímco Hongkong těží ze silné sváteční návštěvnosti z pevniny.
assessment.security_status_en: Regional tensions in Asia continue to mount driven by US military steps, such as the deployment of NMESIS anti-ship systems on Japan's Yonaguni Island, and ongoing provocations by North Korea. On the economic front, China is solidifying its position in critical raw materials via lithium mine expansions and tech collaboration, while Hong Kong benefits from strong holiday mainland visitor arrivals.

assessment.forecast_review_en: The previous forecast focusing on post-holiday consumer data in China and European trade policy was fully confirmed by today's news on strong holiday arrivals and EV tariff debates.

articles.title: Probe launched into luxury One Stanley project over alleged steel bar shortage
articles.summary:
Authorities have launched a probe into the building quality of a luxury residential development in one of Hong Kong’s most expensive neighbourhoods in the Southern district after receiving a complaint from an owner that insufficient steel bars were used during construction.

articles.summary:
Christie’s auctioneer Rupert Banner leans forward with practised showmanship as bidding stalls on a rare Yongzheng bowl near New York’s iconic Rockefeller Centre. He pauses as if willing offers from thin air, scanning dozens of in-person buyers and phone banks connecting with China, London, Texas.

articles.title: US to deploy NMESIS anti-ship system on Japanese island closest to Taiwan for first time
articles.summary:
The US is set to deploy one of its signature anti-ship missile systems to the Japanese island closest to Taiwan, an unprecedented move that comes as tensions in the region between Beijing and Tokyo continue to simmer.
The ground-based US uncrewed missile platform known as the Navy-Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System (NMESIS) will be deployed on Yonaguni Island in Japan’s Okinawa prefecture during biennial joint exercises this month, according to the regional bureau of the Japanese...

articles.title: How US-China RISC-V collaboration is deepening despite chip rivalry
articles.summary:
As global adoption of the open-source RISC-V chip architecture accelerates, US intellectual property provider MIPS is collaborating with Chinese firms at an unprecedented level, according to a senior executive, highlighting how cross-border cooperation persists despite intense tech rivalry between Washington and Beijing.
MIPS, which was acquired by US chipmaker GlobalFoundries last year, was driving RISC-V standardisation “very closely with China”, chief technology officer Yankin Tanurhan said...

articles.title: North Korea test-fires intermediate-range missile amid mine blast tensions
articles.summary:
North Korea said on Saturday it test-fired an intermediate-range ballistic missile that it claimed has manoeuvrable flight capabilities designed to evade missile defences in South Korea and Japan. The latest test comes amid heightened tensions between the two Koreas over border landmine blasts.

articles.title: Hong Kong public universities’ non-local fees jump by up to 26% as quota expands
articles.summary:
Hong Kong public universities will raise undergraduate tuition fees for non-local students studying general courses by up to 26 per cent in the 2027-28 academic year, marking the sharpest increase in recent years as institutions adjust to an expanded quota.

articles.title: Police smash burglary ring that recruited illegal immigrants for 25 break-ins
articles.summary:
Hong Kong police have busted a burglary syndicate that recruited illegal immigrants and is believed to be behind at least 25 break-ins across the city in recent weeks, with stolen cash and valuables exceeding HK$3.6 million (US$458,773).
Six people aged 31 to 45 – five mainlanders and a local resident – were arrested in a Friday operation following a review of surveillance footage, police said.

articles.title: ‘Cancer saved me’: Hong Kong survivor finds new purpose ahead of canoe challenge
articles.summary:
Thirty-one years ago, Hongkonger Raymond Lo Shu-yuen was diagnosed with stage four liver cancer and had a quarter of the organ removed.
Now 75, Lo said the illness, despite its physical and mental toll, had taught him invaluable lessons about ageing, health and making the most of life.
“I can say that the cancer itself saved me,” he said.

articles.title: US, China botanists sign landmark proposal on cooperation, global issues and projects
articles.summary:
The botanical societies of the United States and China have signed a plant science cooperation initiative, vowing to strengthen bilateral ties and foster an open scientific community to tackle global issues.
The joint initiative was signed during a Sino-American botany conference last month in Taian, in China’s eastern Shandong province, which brought together hundreds of experts from institutions in both countries.
The conference, held from September 19 to 23, aimed to “further deepen botanical...

articles.title: Chinese woman, 60, gives birth to second child in 2 years, sparking debate
articles.summary:
A 60-year-old woman in China has captured attention on social media for giving birth to a baby girl, just two years after welcoming a son.
She made the decision to have children at a later stage in life after enduring the loss of her only child four years ago, as reported by the Red Star News.
The infant girl, weighing 2.8kg, was born on September 17 through caesarean section at Zhumadian Central Hospital in Henan province, central China.

articles.title: ‘Balanced and acceptable’: labour chief defends helper wage rise amid criticism
articles.summary:
Hong Kong’s stronger economic performance over the past year was the reason for raising the monthly minimum wage for foreign domestic helpers by 2.35 per cent, the labour minister has said, amid disappointment from both unions and employers’ groups.
Defending the government’s decision to raise the monthly minimum wage to HK$5,220 (US$665), Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun Yuk-han said the government sought to keep the annual adjustment mechanism “balanced and acceptable”.

articles.title: As Saudi Arabia steps up war against Yemen’s Houthis, Pakistan set to play support role
articles.summary:
Pakistani troops are expected to take over various defensive functions for Saudi Arabia to enable the Middle East country to fight an all-out war aimed at defeating Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels.
According to defence analysts, Pakistani troops are not expected to participate directly in ground offensives against the Houthis being planned by Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s squabbling government factions.

articles.title: Prison term ‘karma’, says Hong Kong man freed after 26 years in Philippine jail
articles.summary:
On his 29th birthday, Hong Kong bartender Tang Lung-wai boarded a flight to the Philippines for a holiday that would change his life.
He ended up spending 26 years in jail in the country.
Now 55, Tang spent years fighting his drug-related charges, insisting that he had been framed. But he told the South China Morning Post that he did not view those lost decades solely through the lens of bitterness.

articles.title: Chinese lithium mine registers wider vein, bolstering Beijing’s battery supply
articles.summary:
China has announced the expansion of the resource base for a major lithium deposit in the southwestern province of Sichuan by about 70 per cent, strengthening the country’s potential long-term supply for the metal – an essential component in the production of batteries for electric vehicles (EVs) and energy storage.

articles.title: ‘Better than expected’: 73,800 subdivided flats apply for 3-year grace period
articles.summary:
More than 73,000 owners of subdivided flats in Hong Kong have applied for a three-year grace period to meet the government’s minimum standards, a figure the housing chief has described as “better than expected”.
Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho Wing-yin said on Saturday that authorities received around 73,800 applications during the “early bird” registration phase under the Basic Housing Units Ordinance, which closed on August 31.

articles.title: Restaurant business grows 10% on first 2 days of break as arrivals top 2018 peak
articles.summary:
Mainland Chinese visitor arrivals in Hong Kong during the first two days of the National Day “golden week” surpassed the pre-pandemic total for the same period in 2018, as a catering sector representative reported a 10 per cent year-on-year increase in restaurant receipts.
The tourism chief expressed confidence on Saturday that the city would reach its annual target of 53.8 million visitors earlier than expected.

articles.title: Hong Kong Airport Authority to reshape 11 Skies as a high-end tourism landmark
articles.summary:
The Airport Authority will reposition the 11 Skies commercial project after taking it over next April, with the government expecting it to become a high-end tourism landmark with minimal public investment, the transport chief has said.

articles.title: China returns to top 100 in gender parity ranking for first time since 2016
articles.summary:
For the first time in a decade, China has returned to the top 100 out of 145 economies in an annual global report assessing gender equality.
China closed 69.9 per cent of its gender gap in 2025, rising to 96th place from 103rd the previous year and increasing 1.3 percentage points, according to the 2026 Global Gender Gap Report published by the World Economic Forum (WEF), an international non-profit organisation based in Switzerland.

archive.security_status_cs: Nedávný summit prezidentů USA a Číny ve Washingtone přinesl důraz na spolupráci v oblasti umělé inteligence a stabilizaci obchodních vztahů, což krátkodobě snižuje napětí. Přetrvávají však strukturální spory s EU ohledně zdravotnických zařízení a elektromobilů a napětí v regionu Jihočínského moře a kolem Tchaj-wanu nadále vyžaduje opatrnost.
archive.security_status_en: The recent US-China presidential summit in Washington emphasized AI cooperation and trade relationship stabilization, temporarily easing tensions. However, structural disputes with EU over medical devices and EVs persist, while tensions in the South China Sea and around Taiwan still require caution.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech budou trhy nadále vstřebávat symbolická i věcná gesta ze summitu USA-Čína a sledovat vývoj obchodních jednání mezi Pekingem a Bruselem. Regionální cestovní ruch během svátků v Hongkongu a Číně podpoří sektory maloobchodu a pohostinství.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will continue to digest the symbolic and substantive gestures from the US-China summit while monitoring trade talks between Beijing and Brussels. Regional tourism during holidays in Hong Kong and China will provide support for retail and hospitality sectors.

archive.security_status_cs: Nedávný summit mezi USA a Čínou přinesl dílčí diplomatické uvolnění a dohody o umělé inteligenci či clech, avšak rétorické připomínání válečného spojenectví znervóznilo Tokijské partnery. Současně narůstá regionální napětí v Jihočínském moři a kolem Tchaj-wanu kvůli praktické námořní spolupráci s Manilou.
archive.security_status_en: The recent US-China summit delivered a degree of diplomatic thaw and agreements on AI and tariffs, though nostalgic invocation of wartime alliances unsettled Tokyo partners. Meanwhile, regional friction in the South China Sea and around Taiwan is simmering due to practical maritime cooperation with Manila.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech budou trhy nadále zvažovat dopady americko-čínského summitu na globální obchodní toky, přičemž investoři budou pozorně sledovat reakce japonské diplomacie.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will continue to weigh the US-China summit's impact on global trade flows while closely monitoring Japanese diplomatic reactions.

archive.security_status_cs: Nedávný summit mezi USA a Čínou přinesl částečné snížení napětí, přičemž prezident Donald Trump bagatelizoval neshody ohledně Tchaj-wanu a přispěl k mírnému regionálnímu uklidnění. Současně se globální mocenské soupeření rozšiřuje do rozvojových zemí, což dokládá konkurence o kritické nerostné suroviny v Keni.
archive.security_status_en: The recent US-China summit has brought a partial easing of tensions, with President Donald Trump playing down disagreements over Taiwan and contributing to regional stability. In Hong Kong, institutional developments continue with a focus on technology cooperation in the Hetao hub and adaptive AI governance rules. Simultaneously, great-power competition is expanding into emerging markets, as highlighted by the rivalry over critical minerals in Kenya.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech budou trhy vstřebávat dopady zmírněné rétoriky mezi USA a Čínou, přičemž investoři se zaměří na implementaci technologických dohod v Hongkongu a širší regionální stabilitu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will absorb the impacts of the softened US-China rhetoric, with investors focusing on the implementation of technology agreements in Hong Kong and broader regional stability.

archive.security_status_cs: Prezident Xi Jinping posiluje důraz na vnitřní stabilitu a bezpečnost v předvečer sjezdu strany, zatímco regionální ekonomiku nadále pohání silná globální poptávka po AI a infrastruktuře, jako je nový kanál Pinglu. Zároveň přetrvávají technologická rizika, o čemž svědčí vyšetřování citlivých výzkumníků a přísná opatření vůči dezinformacím.
archive.security_status_en: President Xi Jinping is tightening domestic security focus ahead of the upcoming party congress, while the regional economy continues to be driven by robust global demand for AI and infrastructure projects like the Pinglu Canal. Meanwhile, technological friction persists, highlighted by heightened scrutiny over researchers and measures against online disinformation.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí v regionu zůstává zvýšené kvůli pokračujícímu posilování vojenských a technologických kapacit Číny, včetně pokroků v satelitní koordinaci. archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will likely react to trade negotiations between the EU and Beijing and further developments in tech sanctions. Markets will continue to monitor macroeconomic trends in China.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will likely react to diplomatic initiatives between the US, China, and Russia ahead of the APEC summit and trade agreement developments.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to react to Hong Kong's holiday retail data and ongoing diplomatic maneuvers around the Taiwan Strait.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí se vyostřuje v souvislosti s americkými exportními kontrolami AI serverů a pokusy obcházet sankce přes jihovýchodní Asii. Washington mezitím stupňuje technologický a bezpečnostní tlak, včetně jaderných simulací a snah o zajištění alternativních dodávek kritických surovin, jako je wolfram a lithium.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions are escalating amid US export controls on AI servers and sanctions evasion schemes routed through Southeast Asia.
